title: LensAI — Unified Tenant Cost (LLM + Tool Calls)
description: Dual-write hot/cold tiering board: one query face over infra_ai.inference_events (LensAI's own LLM inference cost events plus tool_call-sourced events dual-written by tool-call-analyzer's pkg/lensai writer), joined against tool_calls for tool-level drill-down. Panels 1-2 need the `trace_id` and `source` columns added to infra_ai.inference_events (additive migration, tracked as a fast-follow in the ingestion/consumer services) -- until then they filter to tenant_id only and `source` reads as empty for pre-dual-write rows.

list.name: tenant_id
list.label: Tenant ID
list.description: Filter every panel to a single tenant_id -- the join key shared by infra_ai.inference_events (native) and tool_calls (via trace_id once dual-write has run).

panels.title: Cost by Source — ${tenant_id}
panels.description: One row per source: 'llm_inference' (or empty, for events written before the source column existed) is native LensAI inference cost; 'tool_call' is cost dual-written from tool-call-analyzer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ifNull(nullIf(source, ''), 'llm_inference') AS source, round(sum(cost_usd), 4) AS cost_usd FROM infra_ai.inference_events WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' GROUP BY source ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
SELECT round(sum(cost_usd), 4) AS cost_usd FROM infra_ai.inference_events WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}'

panels.title: Tool Call Share of Cost — ${tenant_id}
panels.description: Percentage of unified cost attributable to tool_call-sourced dual-write events, vs native LLM inference events.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sumIf(cost_usd, source = 'tool_call') / sum(cost_usd), 2) AS tool_call_pct FROM infra_ai.inference_events WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' AND cost_usd > 0

SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS time, ifNull(nullIf(source, ''), 'llm_inference') AS source, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM infra_ai.inference_events WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' AND timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time, source ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Tool Cost Breakdown by Tool — ${tenant_id}
panels.description: Drill-down from the unified view into tool-level cost, joining tool_calls.trace_id against the tenant's traces once infra_ai.inference_events carries trace_id.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tc.tool_name AS tool_name, round(sum(tc.cost_usd), 4) AS cost_usd FROM tool_calls AS tc WHERE tc.trace_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT trace_id FROM infra_ai.inference_events WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' AND trace_id != '') GROUP BY tc.tool_name ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT model_id, round(sum(cost_usd), 4) AS cost_usd FROM infra_ai.inference_events WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' AND (source = '' OR source = 'llm_inference') GROUP BY model_id ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top Traces by Unified Cost — ${tenant_id}
panels.description: Per-trace total cost combining both pipelines -- requires the trace_id column on infra_ai.inference_events (see dashboard description).

targets.rawSql: SELECT trace_id, ifNull(nullIf(source, ''), 'llm_inference') AS source, count() AS event_count, round(sum(cost_usd), 4) AS cost_usd FROM infra_ai.inference_events WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' AND trace_id != '' GROUP BY trace_id, source ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 50
